prompt: Which method compiles and returns the first element of any List?
choices: public Object first(List list) { return list.get(0); }
public <T> T first(List<T> list) { return list.get(0); }
public T first(List<T> list) { return list.get(0); }
public <T> List<T> first(List<T> list) { return list.get(0); }
explanation: Declare the type parameter <T> before the return type. The return type T and parameter List<T> are consistent. Option A uses raw type (compiles but loses type safety). Option C: T is not declared as a type parameter. Option D: return type List<T> doesn't match list.get(0) which is T.
